entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: 15, 16. By the plea of being a homeborn servant, he intimates his claim on God's covenant love to His people.

entries.title: Psalms 116:17
segments: 17-19. An ampler declaration of his purpose, designating the place, the Lord's house, or earthly residence in Jerusalem.
